content.hook_text: 3 verses I return to when my faith feels small and God feels far

verses.text: The Lord, the Lord, the compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness, maintaining love to thousands, and forgiving wickedness, rebellion and sin.

Where can I go from your Spirit? Where can I flee from your presence? If I go up to the heavens, you are there; if I make my bed in the depths, you are there. If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle on the far side of the sea, even there your hand will guide me, your right hand will hold me fast.

For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor demons, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers, neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

content.cta: Which verse reminds you of who God is? Save this for the hard days. Study all three in SOAPaDay — free & ad-free Bible journal at SOAPaDay.com
content.caption:
Three verses I keep coming back to when everything else feels uncertain.

These aren't quick fixes. They're anchors. The kind you read slowly, out loud, until your breathing changes.

Which one do you need today?
